# Building Nevada's Startup Ecosystem

We have 7 growth programs for founders and 4 affiliated funds to support startup growth.

[I'm a startup](https://startupnv.org/startups/services/)

##### **By Founders, For Founders.**

StartUpNV is where Nevada founders come to build. We connect you to expert-led education, investors, mentors, and a community of people who understand what it takes to grow a company here. Founded by entrepreneurs who have lived the journey, we know that the right people, capital, and knowledge at the right moment makes all the difference. [Join our Community!](https://startupnv.disco.co/)

#### Ground Zero for Nevada Startups

**Incubator Programs**

StartUpNV supports the lifecycle of entrepreneurship throughout Nevada, at every stage. Our incubator programs help entrepreneurs develop and scale ideas from MVP to revenue-producing businesses.

**Accelerator Programs**

Startups that are accepted to our AccelerateNV program receive an investment from affiliated fund, FundNV, and are provided the tools and resources to accelerate the growth of your company to raise additional capital.

FundNV and 1864 are active affiliated investment funds. FundNV is a pre-seed stage fund that focuses solely on Nevada based businesses that will grow jobs in our state. The 1864 Fund is a seed stage fund that goes beyond the state of Nevada to the forgotten middle of our country, typically from the intermountain states to the Mississippi and south. If your company is based in the western coastal states 1864 Fund may consider your application, or the [Sierra Angels](http://www.sierraangels.com/) are a good starting place.

### Ready to Learn How to Invest in Startups?

StartUpNV is a non-profit organization, but the venture funds we facilitate are very much for-profit. They’re committed to attracting and raising venture capital in Nevada, educating and reducing barriers to becoming an investor, and making informed investments in the next big disruptors.

[Get Started](https://startupnv.org/investors)

**Angel Investing**

Part of StartUpNV’s mission is to educate individuals on what it takes to be a good angel investor and how to make smart, successful investments. The right investors and mentors can make all the difference in a startup’s success, and being an early investor in the right companies can provide the greatest returns. Learn more at [www.angelnv.com](http://www.angelnv.com/)

**Venture Funds**

StartUpNV’s affiliated funds have investment committees consisting of exited founders, long-time angel investors and seasoned venture capitalists, and our unique model allows our venture team to spend months to years getting to know founders and their businesses before investing. Visit [Fundnv.com](http://www.fundnv.com/), [1864.Fund](http://www.1864.fund/) and [AngelNV.com](http://www.angelnv.com/) to learn more.

Interested in hearing more about StartUpNV? [Join our newsletter!](https://1em26.share.hsforms.com/2iGlIBZjGQ4ufYw8AVzBcXg)

### **Why StartUpNV?**

- We engage with startups at every stage of the journey.
- We know that it takes a village, or rather an ecosystem, and we’re building it.
- We believe that entrepreneurship is for the brave, not the privileged.
- We do the ultimate diligence.
- We have a ton of fun.
